_provenance.jarSourcePath: projectzomboid.jar (repo root of the PZ Steam install)
_provenance.technique: Structural JVM constant-pool parse via scripts/jar-audit/classfile-parser.mjs (parseClass), not a flat strings/grep pass -- every value here is a genuine CONSTANT_Utf8 entry from the class file.
_provenance.note: Every UTF8 constant-pool string from the relevant server-command classes and their shared command handlers. The regression test asserts that every pattern in rcon.js's KNOWN_RCON_REJECTIONS matches at least one string in this corpus; a pattern matching nothing means the live jar has drifted.
